documents.deleteQuestion: Delete “{title}”? The model stops seeing it. This cannot be undone.
documents.loadFailed: The documents could not be loaded.
documents.noDocsToTry: Add a document to try questions against it.
documents.tplHelp: Pick an example and replace the values with yours.
documents.tpl.term.title: Active customer
documents.tpl.term.body:
Term: Active customer
Meaning: an account of type Customer that has an order in the last 12 months.
CRM: account, customertypecode
Example question: show our active customers
documents.tpl.field.title: Phone number field
documents.tpl.field.body:
Field: Main phone
Meaning: the number we call for a company. Use this field for any “phone number” question.
CRM: account, telephone1
Example question: show accounts with their phone numbers
documents.tpl.avoid.title: Old region field (do not use)
documents.tpl.avoid.body:
Do not use: Region (old)
Use instead: City
Why: the old region field has not been filled in since 2024.
CRM: account, address1_city
Example question: show accounts in Ankara
documents.tpl.rule.title: Big deal
documents.tpl.rule.body:
Rule: a big deal is an opportunity with an estimated value above 100,000.
CRM: opportunity, estimatedvalue
Example question: show the big deals
documents.tpl.policy.title: Support hours
documents.tpl.policy.body:
Topic: Support hours
Explanation: support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00-18:00. Cases opened outside these hours are handled on the next business day.
CRM: incident
Example question: show cases opened outside support hours
